description: Thursday Arena public leaderboard snapshots (GET https://thursdayarena.com/api/public/v1/leaderboard), captured by Mark Yukhimets' local watch routine. Real API responses, unmodified except field selection. captured_at is file mtime (America/Los_Angeles offset included). Key seasons by season.number, never by season.name. Snapshots from 2026-09-17/18 report number 2 and the name 'Season 1'; the current seasons list names that number differently. Snapshot 23 (2026-09-24 14:36 PT) is the PMT draft file site/_draft-local-20260924/data/snapshots/2026-09-24.json, not strategy/data-20260924 and not a Doctor Egg strategy export. Snapshot 24 (2026-09-24 14:39 PT) is unverified because no response copy remains on disk. Some snapshots contain 20 rows and some contain 100; absence from a 20-row snapshot is not absence from the ladder. Row counts are preserved on each snapshot.
